    Prep & aftercare

    How to make it last.

    A great tan is half prep. Here's exactly what to do the day before, the day of, and after.

    Spray tan checklist

    Three days, three lists.

    01

    The day before

    • Shave, wax, or sugar any unwanted body hair
    • Exfoliate with a glove or body brush
    • Get your mani and pedi done
    • Avoid bar and cream-based soaps and body washes
    • Finish any spa or facial treatments
    02

    The day of

    • Do not apply lotions, perfume, deodorant, serums, or oils
    • Do not wear makeup to your appointment
    • Wear dark, loose-fitting clothing
    • Open-toed shoes
    03

    After your tan

    • Let your tan develop — times vary, 2 to 8 hours
    • Avoid working out
    • Avoid moisture until your first rinse
    • Rinse in lukewarm water with no soap
    • Moisturize & hydrate

    Put these on a calendar → Glow Planner

    Policies

    The 48-hour rule.

    All cancellations within 48 hours of your scheduled service are charged a cancellation fee of 50% of the booked service. Rescheduling inside that same window carries the same fee.

    Please be on time to your appointment — tans and faces are booked back to back.
